definition: A named outflow-compound in the āsava family.
notes: This compound should inherit the āsava headword policy. Keep the outflow-family logic explicit so the term does not collapse into plain views or view-clinging. Citation and example removed in the 2026-11-09 Wave 12 audit: DN 33 lists three outflows (`kāmāsavo`, `bhavāsavo`, `avijjāsavo`) and contains no form of `diṭṭhāsava`. The four-outflow list belongs to later sources, so the record is uncited.
